# cfn-lint for the "cfn lint" CI job and the template publish workflow, every version pinned
# and every file hashed; CI installs it with
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes -r aws/requirements-ci.txt

#
# Regenerate from the repository root (Python 3.12, the version the workflows set up):
#   docker run --rm -v "$PWD/aws:/w" -w /w python:3.12-slim sh -c '
#     pip install -q pip-tools==7.4.1 && printf "cfn-lint==1.60.1\n" > /tmp/req.in &&
#     pip-compile --quiet --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe --strip-extras \
#       --no-emit-index-url --no-header --output-file requirements-ci.txt /tmp/req.in'
# then put this comment back on top.
#
